name: Aemulus Holdings Berhad
overview: Aemulus 与 Samsung Electro-Mechanics 就 Silicon Capacitor 功能测试的合作从 MOU 推进至商业供应关系，SEMCO 以采购订单方式采购测试设备；同时公司此前收购的 TMSS 因增资授权到期而继续为全资子公司。
overview_en: Aemulus' collaboration with Samsung Electro-Mechanics on Silicon Capacitor functionality testing progressed from an MOU to a commercial supply relationship, with SEMCO purchasing test equipment via purchase orders; meanwhile, TMSS, previously acquired, remains a wholly-owned subsidiary after the authority to increase its registered capital lapsed.

segments.name: 自动化测试设备
segments.note: 与 SEMCO 的 Silicon Capacitor 测试合作由 MOU 转为商业供应关系，按采购订单销售测试设备。
segments.note_en: The Silicon Capacitor testing collaboration with SEMCO moved from an MOU to a commercial supply relationship, with test equipment sold via purchase orders.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Samsung Electro-Mechanics 的 MOU 目标达成，双方建立商业供应关系，由 SEMCO 不时发出采购订单采购测试设备。
actions.text_en: The MOU with Samsung Electro-Mechanics was fulfilled, establishing a commercial supply relationship where SEMCO issues purchase orders from time to time for test equipment.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 双方正讨论签订联合开发协议，以正式确立在 Silicon Capacitor 功能测试方面的战略长期合作。
actions.text_en: The parties are discussing a joint development agreement to formalise their strategic long-term collaboration in Silicon Capacitor functionality testing.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 此前收购的 TMSS 增资授权到期，TMSS 继续为全资子公司。
segments.note_en: The authority to increase registered capital of previously acquired TMSS lapsed, and TMSS remains a wholly-owned subsidiary.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 授予 TMSS 最多扩大注册资本 60% 供第三方投资者认购的授权已到期，TMSS 继续为 ACSB 的全资子公司。
actions.text_en: The authority for TMSS to increase its registered capital by up to 60% for subscription by third-party investors lapsed; TMSS remains a wholly-owned subsidiary of ACSB.
